# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is noted for being fat, which leads Anne Shirley to consider her unsuitable for playing a fairy queen.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Josie is disagreeable, sulky, and sharp-tongued, often making rude comments to her peers. She is prone to cheating and triumphing ungracefully, and holds superstitious views.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040), [v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)_

## History

Josie attended Avonlea school, where she once peeped in her book during a spelling exercise, only to spell the word incorrectly after Anne Shirley caught her. During a garden gathering, she dared Jane Andrews to hop on one leg and successfully walked the top of the Barry board fence when dared in return by Anne. She grew sulky over not getting the role of the fairy queen in a local concert dialogue, and later caused a three-month feud with Julia Bell after criticizing Julia's recitation bow. At the Exhibition, Josie took first prize for her knitted lace. She joined the Queen's class to study for college, claiming she only sought an education because she was not required to earn her own living. She later attended Queen's Academy, earning a reputation as the sharpest-tongued student there, and was the last of her family line to leave Avonlea school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)_
